structured.answer: I haven't decided, and I'll ask you before I do anything. The page says the cheapest is an account at "פסגות" with a fund called "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", leaving "86,492 ₪" after 10 years, but I don't know either company. If I did it, I'd probably go to לאומי, a bank I know, which the page says leaves "83,396 ₪".

stuck.why: It opens with "להשקיע במדד" and English letters (MSCI, S&P 500). If I hadn't had a task I would have closed it there. To me מדד is the price index on the news.

stuck.where: Screen 1–2, the sliders and the 7% box
stuck.why: I didn't know if I had to change something. I left 10,000 and 500 as they were. I don't know where the "7" in "תשואה בשנה" comes from or whether it is promised.
"−43 ₪ לעומת הבחירה שלכם" has a minus sign and stopped me. I wasn't sure if that one loses money.
The page puts פסגות first, but my own rule is not to give money to a company I don't know. I went back and forth between פסגות and לאומי.
After seven screens of numbers and coloured bars I was tired and stopped at the list of 19 funds.

used: Title "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן"
"הבחירה שלכם · הזול 86,492 ₪ נשאר לכם בעוד 10 שנים"

Fund box: "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", "דמי ניהול: 0% קבועים 0% משתנים"

The English lines "iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF … USD (Accumulating)" and "Interactive Brokers"
The fold arrows on each row
Screens 8 to 19, which I didn't reach
unsure_meaning: S&P 500 / MSCI World / MSCI AC World
ICE / the dotted purple underline under every number
The number 5139282 next to the fund name
not_found: Anything about deposits (פיקדון) or whether this is as safe as one
A plain sentence saying whether I could lose money
Who "מקור" is: no bank or official name I recognised
Why the fund's fees are 0%, and who earns from it then

findings.what: It opens with English letters and an index, and says nothing about risk or safety. Someone like me feels at once that it isn't for them.
findings.where: Screen 1, title and the index buttons

findings.what: The cheapest choice is marked as "הבחירה שלכם" even though I didn't choose anything. I didn't know if I had already picked something.
A minus sign in "−43 ₪" makes the second option look like it loses money, when it only means a bit less.
The "7%" return is put there without saying it is only an example and could be lower or negative.
Too many numbers and coloured bars with colours that are close together (two oranges, yellow, red), and the legend is hard to match.
The "לא בחישוב" notes are long lines that I lost in the middle.
White on black for so many screens tires my eyes. The grey lines are pale.
English fund names in the list are hard to read for someone who doesn't read English.
